prompt: Name a bone in the human body

answers.name: Skull
answers.fact: Made of 22 bones, most fused together.

answers.name: Femur
answers.fact: The longest and strongest bone in the body.

answers.name: Ribs
answers.fact: Most people have 12 pairs.

answers.name: Spine
answers.fact: Starts out as 33 vertebrae; some fuse together later.

answers.name: Pelvis
answers.fact: Its shape differs between men and women, which helps forensic scientists.

answers.name: Collarbone
answers.fact: One of the most commonly broken bones.

answers.name: Kneecap
answers.fact: A baby's kneecaps are mostly cartilage.

answers.name: Stapes
answers.fact: The smallest bone in the body, about 3 mm long.

answers.name: Coccyx
answers.fact: What's left of a tail.

answers.name: Tibia
answers.fact: Carries most of the weight in your lower leg.

answers.name: Fibula
answers.fact: The thin bone beside the tibia; surgeons sometimes borrow bits of it.

answers.name: Humerus
answers.fact: Bang the nerve beside it and you've found your 'funny bone'.

answers.name: Radius
answers.fact: Sits on the thumb side of the forearm.

answers.name: Ulna
answers.fact: Its tip is the point of your elbow.

answers.name: Scapula
answers.fact: The triangle on your upper back.

answers.name: Sternum
answers.fact: Shaped like a sword: handle, blade and tip.

answers.name: Mandible
answers.fact: The only skull bone that moves.

answers.name: Maxilla
answers.fact: Holds your upper teeth.

answers.name: Sacrum
answers.fact: Five vertebrae fused into one.

answers.name: Carpals
answers.fact: Eight small bones in each wrist.

answers.name: Metacarpals
answers.fact: The five long bones in your palm.

answers.name: Phalanges
answers.fact: Each finger has three; each thumb has two.

answers.name: Tarsals
answers.fact: Seven bones in each ankle and rear foot.

answers.name: Metatarsals
answers.fact: Footballers famously break the fifth one.

answers.name: Calcaneus
answers.fact: The biggest bone in the foot.

answers.name: Talus
answers.fact: Ancient dice were made from animal ankle bones.

answers.name: Incus
answers.fact: One of the three tiny ear bones, shaped like an anvil.

answers.name: Malleus
answers.fact: The ear's 'hammer'.

answers.name: Vertebra
answers.fact: Humans and giraffes both have seven neck vertebrae.

answers.name: Atlas
answers.fact: The top vertebra, named after the Titan who held up the heavens.

answers.name: Axis
answers.fact: The second vertebra: it lets your head turn side to side.

answers.name: Frontal bone
answers.fact: Forms your forehead.

answers.name: Parietal bone
answers.fact: Two of them make the top and sides of the skull.

answers.name: Temporal bone
answers.fact: Houses the inner ear.

answers.name: Occipital bone
answers.fact: The back of the skull, with the hole the spinal cord passes through.

answers.name: Sphenoid
answers.fact: Shaped like a butterfly.

answers.name: Ethmoid
answers.fact: A light, spongy bone between the eyes.

answers.name: Zygomatic bone
answers.fact: Your cheekbone.

answers.name: Nasal bone
answers.fact: Forms the bridge of the nose.

answers.name: Vomer
answers.fact: Named after the Latin for ploughshare.

answers.name: Palatine bone
answers.fact: Forms part of the roof of the mouth.

answers.name: Scaphoid
answers.fact: The most commonly broken wrist bone.

answers.name: Lunate
answers.fact: Named for its crescent-moon shape.

answers.name: Trapezium
answers.fact: Sits at the base of the thumb.

answers.name: Trapezoid
answers.fact: The trapezium's next-door neighbour.

answers.name: Capitate
answers.fact: The largest wrist bone.

answers.name: Hamate
answers.fact: Has a little hook that can snap when swinging a golf club or bat.

answers.name: Navicular
answers.fact: Boat-shaped: 'navis' is Latin for ship.

answers.name: Cuboid
answers.fact: A cube-ish bone on the outside of the foot.

answers.name: Cuneiform
answers.fact: Wedge-shaped, like the ancient script.

answers.name: Ilium
answers.fact: The big wing-shaped part of the pelvis.

answers.name: Ischium
answers.fact: The bit you sit on.

answers.name: Pubis
answers.fact: The front of the pelvis.

answers.name: Lacrimal
answers.fact: The smallest bone of the face, near the tear ducts.

answers.name: Triquetrum
answers.fact: Latin for 'three-cornered'.

answers.name: Pisiform
answers.fact: Pea-shaped, the smallest wrist bone.

answers.name: Inferior nasal concha
answers.fact: A curled bone inside the nose that warms incoming air.

answers.name: Hyoid
answers.fact: The only bone not joined to any other bone.
